1) db.currentOp({\"secs_running\":{$gt:5: 1) Run db.currentOp({"secs_running":{$gt:5}}) to find long-running operations and db.killOp(opid) to stop the bleeding if needed; 2) Enable the profiler to find slow queries: db.setProfilingLevel(1,100), then db.system.profile.find().sort({millis:-1}).limit(10); 3) Run explain("executionStats") on the slow queries to see whether they do a COLLSCAN and add indexes; 4) Check whether a bulk write or an index rebuild is saturating disk IO.
1) db.serverStatus().connections 确认 curr: 1) Run db.serverStatus().connections to see the real current and available levels; 2) Run db.currentOp(true) and group by client to find the application with an abnormal connection count; 3) Tell business growth apart from a driver connection pool leak (maxPoolSize set too high, or the MongoClient is not reused); 4) As an emergency measure raise net.maxIncomingConnections on mongod, and confirm the system ulimit -n is high enough.
1) db.serverStatus().metrics.cursor 看 ti: 1) Run db.serverStatus().metrics.cursor and watch timedOut against open.total; 2) On the application side, confirm cursors are close()d after use and that a single batch does not take too long; 3) For long traversals use noCursorTimeout and manage the lifecycle yourself, or lower batchSize to consume faster; 4) Check whether a slow query is holding a cursor past cursorTimeoutMillis (10 minutes by default).
1) db.serverStatus().wiredTiger.cache 看: 1) Run db.serverStatus().wiredTiger.cache and compare "bytes currently in the cache" against the configured limit; 2) Compare db.stats() and index sizes against physical memory to judge whether the working set exceeds RAM; 3) Start by dropping unused indexes and archiving cold data to shrink the working set; 4) Confirm the host is not swapping, and add memory or shard if necessary.
1) 在主节点执行 rs.status()，对比各成员的 optimeDate: 1) Run rs.status() on the primary and compare optimeDate and lastHeartbeat across members to find the lagging one; 2) On the lagging node, check the mongod log for oplog fetch errors or disk IO bottlenecks; 3) On the primary, run db.currentOp() to check whether a bulk write is flooding the oplog faster than the secondary can apply; 4) If it falls behind the oplog window the secondary needs a fresh initial sync — move read traffic away first.
1) 用 db.adminCommand({getLog:\"global\"}: 1) Run db.adminCommand({getLog:"global"}) to see the context of the asserts in the log; 2) Run db.serverStatus().asserts to see whether the regular or message counter is growing; 3) Regular asserts usually point to the storage layer — check disk health and data file integrity; message asserts usually mean a protocol or driver mismatch, so verify the driver version; 4) Check whether it lines up with a recent upgrade or schema change.
1) 登录主机用 systemctl status mongod 或 docke: 1) Log in to the host and run systemctl status mongod or docker ps to confirm the process is alive; 2) If it is alive, connect by hand with mongosh to tell a hung instance apart from a network or authentication problem; 3) If it is not running, read the tail of the log to identify the cause (OOM, full disk, corrupted data files) before starting it — do not blindly restart; 4) For a replica set, run rs.status() immediately to confirm failover completed and that the application has taken this node out of rotation.
1) 看 mongod 日志尾部确认是崩溃、被 OOM kill 还是人工重启；: 1) Read the tail of the mongod log to tell a crash, an OOM kill and a manual restart apart; 2) If it was an OOM, compare wiredTigerCacheSizeGB against host memory and lower it; 3) For a replica set, run rs.status() to confirm a new primary was elected automatically and applications reconnected; 4) For an unplanned restart, check whether systemd or the container orchestrator is repeatedly restarting it.
MongoDB 出现 assert 错误，通常伴随查询失败或内部异常，持续出现说: MongoDB is reporting assert errors, usually alongside failed queries or internal exceptions; persistent occurrences mean there is a reproducible problem.
MongoDB 出现缺页中断，工作集已经放不进内存，读请求要落盘，延迟会明显上升: MongoDB is taking page faults: the working set no longer fits in memory, reads have to hit disk and latency will rise noticeably.
MongoDB 在 1 分钟内重启过，重启期间连接全部中断、WiredTiger: MongoDB restarted within the last minute; all connections dropped and the WiredTiger cache started cold, so the workload will be unstable for a while.
MongoDB 已用连接数达到上限的 80%，触顶后新连接会被直接拒绝，应用报连: MongoDB connections in use have reached 80% of the limit; once it tops out new connections are rejected outright and the application reports connection failures.
MongoDB 平均操作延迟超过 250 毫秒，读写请求明显变慢，上游应用会出现: MongoDB average operation latency is above 250 milliseconds: reads and writes are noticeably slower and upstream applications will see timeouts and request pile-up.
副本集成员间的 optime 差值已超过 30 秒，从节点数据明显落后，读偏好走: The optime difference between replica set members is over 30 seconds: the secondary is clearly behind, and read traffic with a secondary read preference will see stale data.
有游标因超时被服务端回收，说明应用取数据太慢或游标没及时关闭，分页与遍历类查询会: Cursors are being reclaimed by the server after timing out, which means the application fetches data too slowly or does not close cursors; paginated and traversal queries will fail midway.
采集端已连不上 MongoDB，实例可能已崩溃或网络不通，依赖该库的业务全部不可: The collector can no longer reach MongoDB; the instance may have crashed or the network may be down, and every workload depending on this database is unavailable.
